units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 20) organizes professional education and additional professional education for municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and employees of municipal institutions;
units.label: Subpoint 20 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 21) may be a member of the governing bodies of a business entity in which the municipality holds shares or an interest in the authorized capital, and participate in managing its affairs (without receiving personal income);
units.label: Subpoint 21 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 22) delegates to municipal servants powers to participate in the governing bodies of business entities (without receiving personal income) in which the municipality holds shares or an interest in the authorized capital;
units.label: Subpoint 22 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 23) exercises other powers established by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and decisions of the City Duma.
units.label: Subpoint 23 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The Head of Yekaterinburg also exercises other powers assigned to them by federal legislation, legislation of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and decisions of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. The Head of Yekaterinburg may form permanent (temporary) collegial and public bodies (collegia, councils, committees, commissions and others) to discuss and prepare decisions on matters of local significance of the municipality.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. During the temporary absence of the Head of Yekaterinburg, the powers provided for by point 2 of this Article of the Charter are exercised, on the Head’s executive order, by the First Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg or one of the Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. The Head of Yekaterinburg may not:
units.label: Point 6 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) engage in entrepreneurial activities personally or through authorized representatives; participate in managing a commercial or non-profit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 6 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: unpaid participation in managing a political party or a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body; participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 6 Art. 35 · “unpaid participation in managing a political party or a trade…”

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: unpaid participation in managing a non-profit organization (other than participation in managing a political party or a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners), with prior notification of the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast according to the procedure established by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 6 Art. 35 · “unpaid participation in managing a non-profit organization…”

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: unpaid representation of the municipality’s interests in the council of municipalities of Sverdlovsk Oblast, other associations of municipalities, and their governing bodies;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 6 Art. 35 · “unpaid representation of the municipality’s interests in the…”

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: unpaid representation of the municipality’s interests in the governing bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, member) is the municipality, in accordance with municipal legal acts determining the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization’s founder on behalf of the municipality or the procedure for managing municipally owned shares (interests in authorized capital);
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 6 Art. 35 · “unpaid representation of the municipality’s interests in the…”

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: other cases provided for by federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 6 Art. 35 · “other cases provided for by federal laws;”

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) engage in other paid activities, except teaching, scientific and other creative activities. Teaching, scientific and other creative activities may not be financed exclusively from funds of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens and stateless persons, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 6 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) be a member of governing bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign non-profit non-governmental organizations and their structural subdivisions operating within the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 6 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is the municipality’s executive and administrative local self-government body, vested with its own powers to resolve matters of local significance.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is directed by the Head of Yekaterinburg on the principle of sole authority. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg has the rights of a legal entity.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. The legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are resolutions and executive orders.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg issue executive orders and administrative orders on matters concerning their activities.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. Expenditure to support the activities of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is provided for as a separate line in the municipal budget in accordance with the expenditure classification of the budgets of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises all executive and administrative powers concerning matters of local significance of the municipality in accordance with federal and oblast legislation, decisions of the City Duma and legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, including:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) ensures the preparation of, and prepares, the draft municipal budget (the draft municipal budget and medium-term financial plan), and ensures execution of the municipal budget and preparation of budget reporting;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1-1) establishes the procedure for developing an action plan to implement the municipality’s socio-economic development strategy, the procedure for preparing a forecast of the municipality’s socio-economic development, and the forms and procedure for preparing the municipality’s medium-term financial plan;
units.label: Subpoint 1-1 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1-2) establishes the procedure for adopting decisions to develop municipal programmes and the procedure for drawing up municipal assignments;
units.label: Subpoint 1-2 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) undertakes municipal borrowing, issues municipal guarantees and manages municipal debt;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) issues municipal bonds and other securities according to the procedure established by current legislation and the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4) develops the draft strategy for the municipality’s socio-economic development and ensures implementation of the approved strategy;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4-1) develops and approves an action plan to implement the municipality’s socio-economic development strategy and municipal programmes to be implemented using municipal budget funds, ensures their implementation and prepares reports on their implementation;
units.label: Subpoint 4-1 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4-2) prepares and approves a forecast of the municipality’s socio-economic development;
units.label: Subpoint 4-2 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5) develops and implements the municipality’s financial and investment policy and takes measures to support and develop entrepreneurship;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6) develops the procedure for possessing, using and disposing of municipally owned property;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 7) develops the procedure for adopting decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal enterprises and institutions;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 8) is the body authorized to select suppliers (service providers, contractors) for contracting authorities;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 9) possesses, uses and disposes of municipally owned property, including municipal land;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10) implements pricing and remuneration policy;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10-1) develops and approves the layout scheme for non-stationary trading facilities according to the procedure established by the authorized executive body of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 10-1 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 11) organizes and directs the consumer protection system in the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 12) provides organizational and logistical support for the preparation and conduct of municipal elections, local referendums, voting to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, and voting on changes to the municipality’s boundaries and on transformation of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 13) participates in activities relating to guardianship and trusteeship;
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 13-1) participates in preventing terrorism and extremism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of manifestations of terrorism and extremism within the boundaries of the municipality, including:
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: develops and implements municipal programmes for preventing terrorism and minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of its manifestations;
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37 · “develops and implements municipal programmes for preventing…”

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: organizes and conducts information and awareness-raising activities in the municipality to explain the nature of terrorism and its danger to society and to foster citizens’ rejection of terrorist ideology, including through the distribution of information materials and printed products, explanatory work and other activities;
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37 · “organizes and conducts information and awareness-raising…”

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: participates in measures to prevent terrorism and to minimize and/or eliminate the consequences of its manifestations, organized by federal executive bodies and/or executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37 · “participates in measures to prevent terrorism and to minimize…”

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: ensures compliance with anti-terrorist protection requirements for facilities that are municipally owned or under the jurisdiction of the municipality’s local self-government bodies;
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37 · “ensures compliance with anti-terrorist protection requirements…”

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: submits proposals to executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast on participation in preventing terrorism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of its manifestations;
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37 · “submits proposals to executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast on…”

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: exercises other powers to resolve matters of local significance concerning participation in preventing terrorism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of its manifestations;
units.label: Subpoint 13-1 Point 1 Art. 37 · “exercises other powers to resolve matters of local significance…”

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 14) exercises other powers to resolve matters of local significance of the municipality in accordance with federal and oblast legislation and this Charter.
units.label: Subpoint 14 Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises specific state powers where they are transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast according to the established procedure.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is developed by the Head of Yekaterinburg and approved by the City Duma. The staffing schedule of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and the standard structure of district administrations are established independently by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. Within the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, posts are established for the First Deputy Head, Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg, the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, and heads of district administrations; their powers are determined by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg consists of sectoral (functional) and territorial bodies.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. Sectoral (functional) bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercise powers to manage sectors of the local economy and the social sphere.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. A body of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg for municipal property management is formed to support the activities of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg in managing and disposing of municipal property and acquiring and exercising the municipality’s property rights and obligations.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. A financial body of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg with the rights of a legal entity is established to support the activities of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg in drawing up and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution and preparing budget reporting.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 7. The territorial bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are district administrations.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 8. To provide organizational, legal, information, financial, documentary and logistical support for the activities of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, its staff is formed, headed by the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or by the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Point 8 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 9. The organization of work and powers of bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg that do not have the rights of a legal entity are determined by regulations on those bodies approved by legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 9 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10. Bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg may be established and granted the rights of a legal entity by a decision of the City Duma. Regulations on such bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are approved by the City Duma on the submission of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 38-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 38 · “Article 38-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City…”
